hours: Normal Trail hours Weekends & Holidays 9am – 4:30pm & non-holiday Mon-Fri 10am- 4:30pm.

notes.text: November 13 – Almost!!! One to two inches wet snow on the ground this morning, more on colder surfaces. I skied most of Lake Trail with rock skis (old Karhus, lots of MaxiGlide) and it was fun but not good enough to share. We expect this snow to melt over the next few days, but we do hope to be skiing soon!
Stats for the 2025-26 season: First ski day was November 30, last ski day was April 1. Total of 116 ski days, 103″ snow.
